name: Municipal Corporation Mathura-Vrindavan
headquarters: Bhuteshwar Jalkal Compound, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh 281001
description: Uttar Pradesh notified one municipal corporation for the scheduled areas of the former Mathura and Vrindavan municipal councils on 12 May 2017. The State Election Commission lists 70 corporation wards. The corporation does not cover the entire Mathura district.
